summary: This is a mypy configuration file that enables strict type checking for a Python project. It turns on all available type safety checks, then disables just one problematic check (attr-defined) that was causing false positives. The configuration targets Python 3.13 and stores its cache in a temporary directory.

explanations.5: strict = True enables all of mypy's strictest type-checking rules at once, rather than having to enable them individually.
explanations.10: This disables the 'attr-defined' error code specifically, allowing the code to run despite mypy incorrectly reporting that certain attributes don't exist.
explanations.12: This tells mypy where to store its cache files (temporary data it uses to speed up future checks), set to the /tmp directory which gets cleaned up by the system.
explanations.15: This requires that every function must have type hints for its parameters and return value; mypy will error if any are missing or incomplete.
explanations.23: This tells mypy to assume the code is being run on Python version 3.13, so it can check for compatibility and use features available in that version.
